channel.title: Pier & Point · Byers Hall
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Byers Hall (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Byers Hall: The opening date said June 2005 with only a website domain as its citation; the UCSF history page gives only 2005, so it now reads 2005 and cites that page. Block 24C is confirmed by UCSF's June 2025 CAC presentation map ('BYERS HALL (24C)'), which is now cited for the map shape. The wording 'built as a hub for academia-biotech collaboration' was replaced with what the sources say: QB3's director's office and administration are here (Wikipedia), and a former project manager's portfolio page says the building provides space for collaboration between academic researchers and industry; the 1700 4th St address now cites OSM. The UC Regents presentation photo was labelled taken 2008 and 'presentation to the Committee on Grounds and Buildings'; the PDF dates only the presentation (September 2008) and never names that committee, so the photo date was removed, the caption says the date is not stated, and the committee is no longer named. The Wikimedia aerial credit names only the Commons username Firstcultural.

item.title: Planned · Byers Hall: UC Regents Committee on Grounds and Buildings certifies a CEQA EIR addendum and approves the design of the California Institute for Bioengineering, Biotechnology, and Quantitative Biomedical Research (QB3) Building at Mission Bay -- this building, per QB3's own use of Byers Hall as its headquarters (Mar 14, 2002)
